old_problem: The absent HSC specification determines which transactions merely observe status and which can affect gate enable, current limits, resets or fault latches. DeepSeek's generic scan cannot select or map a hot-swap channel and may disturb a live whole-system power boundary while providing no power-good/load correlation.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. HSC identity, channel/gate/load mapping, register semantics, expected fault/power-good state and independent recovery define the test and its safety boundary. They cannot be inferred from I2C presence or supplied later as arbitrary parameters. No bus access is reviewable until the project/OEM power-gate contract exists.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1805, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1806 / Wistron-HW-00008-V003 / edd92d2e81d957ba.
HSC_BD defaults to BMC/platform-management scope and requires a named controller/mux/address plus channel-aware register map.
Identity, telemetry, fault latches, current limits and gate control can coexist at one HSC address; address discovery provides no safe-operation proof.
ED-03 prohibits guessed OEM routes/registers and ED-15 prohibits PASS without approved voltage/current/power-good/fault acceptance.
Independent recovery cannot rely solely on the hot-swap controller path under test, and no automatic retry, reset or power cycle is allowed.
No SSH, I2C, HSC, hot-swap, power, scan, write, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: HSC-board channel/status verification with unchanged power gates — blocked pending contract
test_case.purpose: Verify named hot-swap-controller channels through allowlisted identity/status/telemetry reads while proving gate, current-limit, latch, output, redundancy and management state remain unchanged.
required_package: Approved HSC board specification/revision and physical channel/gate/load topology
BMC/OOB controller, mux route, bus/address and exact safe identity/status/telemetry register allowlist
Gate-enable, current-limit, reset, latch-clear, fault-injection, force, quick-write and write exclusions
Expected per-channel voltage/current/power-good/fault/limit values, units and abort thresholds
Stable load/redundancy state, approved tool/version, maintenance authorization and independent console/BMC/power recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED; perform no HSC bus access. After the complete HSC contract and fresh review authorize execution, establish stable load/redundancy and independent recovery, use secure BMC/OOB access to the exact controller/mux path, and read only allowlisted identity/status/telemetry registers on named channels. Capture complete raw and converted values with synchronized PSU/PDB, power-good, BMC SEL/SDR and OS state. Never globally scan, touch gate/limit/reset/latch/fault-control space, force/write, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: No current executable PASS exists. In a future authorized run, each HSC channel identity and raw/status value must match the approved map, every voltage/current/power-good/fault condition must meet its criterion, and gate/output/load/redundancy/BMC/OS state must remain unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. Address presence cannot PASS. Future PASS requires exact route/channel/register/response agreement and clean synchronized power-state evidence. Missing contract, wrong channel, unapproved register, response/fault mismatch, gate/output/current/redundancy change, evidence gap or management anomaly is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict.
safety_gate: Do not access HSC buses until channel/gate mapping and the register-level safe-read matrix are approved.
Prohibit generic scans and all gate, current-limit, reset, latch-clear, fault-injection, force, quick-write or write operations.
Confirm stable load/redundancy and independent recovery; preserve synchronized HSC/PSU/PDB/BMC evidence.
Stop on any gate, power-good, current, fault, output, management or bus change; do not retry or power-cycle automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved HSC specification/revision and channel/gate/load topology
Controller/mux/bus/address/register allowlist, exclusions, tool/version and authenticated session audit
Complete per-channel raw identity/status/telemetry mapped to voltage/current/power-good/fault criteria
Synchronized gate/output/load/redundancy, PSU/PDB, BMC SEL/SDR and OS baselines/deltas
Abort/no-retry/independent-power-recovery audit and power/platform owner verdict
test_case.recovery: No access or recovery action is authorized now. In a future approved run, stop on the first gate, power or management anomaly, preserve all evidence and do not retry. Use the independent console/BMC/power recovery path; HSC reset, latch clear, failover, reboot or power cycle requires a separate approved procedure and authorization.
